BERE.name: Bear To Registered
BERE.definition: Change from bearer into registered form.

CERT.name: Certificates
CERT.definition: Change of all instruments into certificates.

DEPH.name: Dematerialised To Physical
DEPH.definition: Change from dematerialised into physical form.

GPPH.name: Global Permanent To Physical
GPPH.definition: Change from global permanent to physical form.

GTGP.name: Global Temporary To Global Permanent
GTGP.definition: Change from global temporary to global permanent form.

GTPH.name: Global Temporary To Physical
GTPH.definition: Change from global temporary to physical form.

NAME.name: Name
NAME.definition: The issuing company changes its name. CA event shows the change from old name to new name and may involve surrendering physical shares with the old name to the registrar.

PHDE.name: Physical To Dematerialised
PHDE.definition: Change from physical into dematerialised form.

REBE.name: Registered To Bearer
REBE.definition: Change from registered into bearer form.

TERM.name: Terms
TERM.definition: Change in the terms of the security.

DECI.name: Decimalisation
DECI.definition: Process of changing the accounting method of a security, for example, mutual fund, from units to a quantity with decimals.
